name: SONAR KYB (Remote)
description: Hosted endpoint of the official SONAR MCP server, with the same seven tools as the getsonar-mcp package: KYB due diligence on vendors, partners and resellers from public records (company register lookup and officers in 10+ countries, sanctions and PEP screening, ICIJ Offshore Leaks, owners, adverse media, and full written KYB reports). Paid per call from a prepaid SONAR balance; first call free. Authenticates with OAuth 2.1 (discovery and dynamic client registration).
